minutes.headline: Board set the FY27 town meeting warrant and voted a two-tier override question onto the town election ballot
minutes.summary: The Select Board worked through the annual town meeting warrant article by article with town counsel, deferring several items (prior-year invoices, FY26 budget adjustments, the snow-and-ice closeout, and union contract funding) to town meeting itself, and declining -- after individual members stated concerns -- to include a Trust Fund Commission legal-fees article or a quorum bylaw article that counsel flagged as legally uncertain. The board voted to place a two-tier Proposition 2½ override question on the annual town election ballot, rounding the tiers to clean dollar figures and choosing a "Question 1/Question 2" ballot format, while one member stated ongoing concerns about the override's affordability. It also discussed but did not finalize where the override and other articles should sit in the warrant order and consent agenda.

what_happened.line: Board voted 5-0 to place a two-tier Proposition 2½ override question on the annual town election ballot, pending town counsel's final edits.
Board members individually declined to put two Trust Fund Commission articles, on legal fees and a quorum bylaw, on the town meeting warrant.
The board deferred several FY27 warrant items, including prior-year invoices and union contract funding, to town meeting itself.
A Trust Fund Commission representative told the board the commission has filed a notice of breach of fiduciary duty against the town.

why_it_matters: The override question, if it proceeds as set, will ask voters at the annual town election to approve additional property tax collection above the state cap, split into two tiers residents can vote on separately.

Sending prior-year invoices, FY26 budget adjustments, and union contract funding to town meeting itself means those costs will be settled by the voters present rather than decided in advance by the board.
The declined Trust Fund Commission articles and the fiduciary-duty notice point to an unresolved dispute between that commission and the town that may surface again at town meeting.
